## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (60%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Grade-3 blur flagged reliability [F6], Normal (40%) remains unseparated, and the frozen-section margin call is deferred [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 60%, Normal 40%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Split between Benign and Normal |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% dataset target, n=132) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 38% (flagged), OOD 42%, blur 3 | Suspect input from severe blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match Benign (all 5 Normal, 90%–91%) [F5] | Nearest neighbors all favor Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.16) pushes away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (1.07), but unreliable (0/20 spot check) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (1.19) pushes away from invasive; caption inconsistent [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.34) slightly offsets benign-leaning score (12/20 check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random removal (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 AI spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- True class is Normal, matching all 5 nearest reference cases (90%–91% similarity) and the 40% Normal probability.
- Grade-3 blur obscured diagnostic morphology or distorted frozen-section margin scores (inferior 96%, medial 75%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: Highest risk (0.006, 0.009) near inferior/medial margins (up to 96%); check blur and drafted recut/levels.
2. **Regions 1, 6, 7**: Inspect gland/tubule architecture and ducts separating Benign from Normal contrast case BACH_0236.
3. **Regions 0, 2**: Verify absent stromal invasion in region 0 and unreliable normal-lobule region 2.
